lf-motion.description: A shared, scrubbable clock for authored animation studies, with play, pause, reset and playback speed. Its body holds the drawings being compared.
lf-motion.x-instructions: The page module waits for customElements.whenDefined('lf-motion'), then assigns element.renderFrame = time => { ... }. Time is milliseconds from 0 to duration. Assignment draws the current frame immediately; every seek and playback frame calls it synchronously. Draw all views from that time, including when it moves backward. Read or set currentTime to inspect an exact instant; setting it pauses and clamps to the duration. The widget supplies playback controls and starts paused. Its authored body and layout stay yours. Describe the illustration and timing basis; use lf-trace for captured runtime evidence.
